title: BizJet Pilot Begins Its Journey
summary: BizJet Pilot begins its journey, bringing business aviation enthusiasts a dedicated home for flight simulation news, aircraft reviews, tutorials and live flying.
body:
Welcome to BizJet Pilot, a new independent destination dedicated to business aviation in the virtual world.

Our focus is on the fascinating world of business jet flight simulation, with particular attention to Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 and X-Plane 12.

![Business jet cockpit at sunset](/assets/flightdeck-route-background.webp)

As the site develops, we'll be bringing you aircraft and add-on reviews, simulator news, practical tutorials and live flying content. From flight planning and cockpit procedures to exploring new virtual business jets, our aim is to make the experience informative, accessible and enjoyable.

BizJet Pilot is starting small, but we have plenty of ideas for the journey ahead.

Thank you for joining us at the beginning.

**BizJet Pilot — Business Aviation in the Virtual World.**
image_caption: Business Aviation in the Virtual World — the journey begins.
